_comment: Harness config. limits: the Big-plan spend caps (USD) the proxy enforces per workflow run and per rolling week. models: what CodeAF may use, served to it by `harness proxy` as an OpenRouter-shaped catalog; prices are USD per million tokens, from https://synthetic.new/pricing, checked 2026-10-17. input/output/cache_read are the SUBSCRIPTION rates, which draw down the weekly credit; api_input/api_cached/api_output are the API list rates, what usage past the quota (overage) costs. 'id' is what CodeAF sees; 'upstream' is the synthetic.new model id. 'max_concurrent': the synthetic.new subscription allows 2 calls to each model at once; the proxy queues calls past that. queue.max_parallel_runs is how many CodeAF runs the queue may have going at once; each run gets its own slice of every model's max_concurrent (perRunSlots: max(1, max_concurrent/max_parallel_runs), what task.parallel is set to) and its own worker seat, chosen by the lane the queue assigns. searches_per_run caps the web-search calls (harness search, POST /v2/search) one run may forward to synthetic.new; search is in the plan and draws no credit, but the cap walls off a runaway loop (issue #58). planner (issue #61): when the queue sees fewer than min_backlog codeaf-queued issues open and no plan run started within min_hours, harness plan-check tells the queue job to dispatch one CodeAF run in plan mode (a read-only pass whose proposals are labelled codeaf-proposed, never codeaf-queued); max_proposals caps what one plan run may propose.

limits.plan_note: Big plan $90/mo. The weekly credit is not published; 22 is an ESTIMATE from GET /v2/quotas on 2026-10-17 (weeklyTokenLimit.percentRemaining fell 1.41% for $0.306 of subscription-rate usage). The hard stop is synthetic.new's own percentRemaining: with overage_usd 0, the proxy refuses below min_credit_percent, re-reading /v2/quotas every 5 minutes. run_credit_usd replaces the old run_usd. overage_usd 0 = stop rather than pay past the quota.

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash (synthetic.new)
models.efforts_note: low, minimal and medium are sent as medium (owner's decision, 2026-10-17): measured on a real multi-step Go edit-and-test task (issue #24, 3 repeats per case) medium saved 19.3% median completion tokens and 17.8% median wall time at equal correctness, and about 72% of this model's output is reasoning. low is never sent raw: GLM returns empty answers at low

models.name: GLM-5.3 (synthetic.new)
models.efforts_note: low, minimal and medium are all sent as medium: equal correctness (3/3 vs 3/3, 0 empty answers, 0 malformed tool calls) and a real saving (median completion 1332->854, i.e. 35.9% fewer; median wall 26.3->17.8 s, 32.1% less), so medium is sent raw to synthetic.new; low is still never sent raw because GLM returns an empty answer (tested 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16; measured 2026-10-17, results.md, issue #24)

models.name: Kimi-K3 (synthetic.new)
models.efforts_note: role experiment: never picked by a lane, only by a model-experiment profile (experiments.json). Prices from https://synthetic.new/pricing/models, 2026-10-17. Whether it honours reasoning_effort is unverified.
